WITH RankedRules AS
(
    SELECT
        dqr.record_id AS RuleID,
        tc.source_schema,
        tc.source_table,
        dqr.column_name,
        dqr.rule_name,
        dqr.rule_type,
        dqr.severity,
        dqr.table_configuration_id,
        ROW_NUMBER() OVER
        (
            PARTITION BY
                tc.source_schema,
                tc.source_table,
                dqr.column_name,
                dqr.rule_name,
                dqr.rule_type,
                dqr.rule_expression,
                dqr.severity,
                dqr.comparison_operator,
                dqr.allowed_values,
                dqr.comparison_value
            ORDER BY dqr.record_id
        ) AS rn
    FROM metadata.DataQualityRules AS dqr
    INNER JOIN metadata.TableConfigurations AS tc
        ON tc.record_id = dqr.table_configuration_id
    WHERE dqr.is_active = 1
      AND tc.is_active = 1
)
SELECT
    RuleID,
    source_schema,
    source_table,
    column_name,
    rule_name,
    rule_type,
    severity,
    table_configuration_id
FROM RankedRules
WHERE rn = 1
ORDER BY source_schema, source_table, RuleID;
